verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a fraud-detection platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a hosted service: you send data from your application to Sift via its REST, Decisions and Score APIs. Nothing documents an on-premises or self-hosted deployment of the core product, and the sandbox is a hosted test environment, not a self-hosting option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
